entries.name: NOVA Video Player
entries.text: Supernova is based on Nova Video Player 6.4.64. Thank you to the NOVA Video Player project and its contributors. Supernova contains modifications to the upstream application. Original copyright and licence notices are preserved in Open-source Licences. No endorsement is implied.

entries.name: Archos Video Player Community Edition / Archos
entries.text: NOVA Video Player descends from Archos Video Player Community Edition. Thank you to Archos and the original contributors. Applicable Archos SA copyright and Apache 2.0 notices are preserved in the source and local Open-source Licences. This acknowledgement does not imply sponsorship or endorsement.

entries.name: TMDB
entries.text: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

entries.name: JustWatch via TMDB
entries.text: Streaming availability information is supplied by JustWatch through TMDB's watch-provider data. Availability can change and does not guarantee account entitlement, a subscription or playback. Supernova is not endorsed by these providers.

entries.name: Trakt
entries.text: Supernova includes the existing optional Trakt account, scrobbling and watched-history integration. Trakt is a third-party service; this acknowledgement does not imply endorsement or partnership. Account access remains optional and requires the user's own authentication.

entries.name: OpenSubtitles.com
entries.text: Supernova includes the existing OpenSubtitles.com REST API integration for subtitle discovery and download. Access depends on the user's account, service availability and applicable provider limits. OpenSubtitles.com does not endorse or certify Supernova.
